tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground: Paper in light, Night in dark. The ground for every logo version except white.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Cloud / Graphite. Search fields and quiet panels on bg. Every text color that works on bg works here.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Mist / Steel. 1px hairlines between rows and around fields. Decorative only (1.2–1.4:1); never the only edge of a control that must be found.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Ink / Fog. Headings, body copy and the wordmark on bg and soft: 17.8:1 and 16.3:1 in light, 15.8:1 and 14.1:1 in dark.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Slate / Ash. Counts, notes, section labels on bg and soft: 5.9:1 and 5.4:1 in light, 7.7:1 and 6.9:1 in dark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Indigo / Periwinkle: the brand color. The Follow button, links, focus rings, the mark's disc. On bg 7.1:1 (light) and 7.3:1 (dark); never Indigo on a dark ground (2.6:1).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Indigo Deep / Periwinkle Light. Hover and pressed states of links and buttons on bg: 10.8:1 and 10.3:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (the Follow button): Paper on Indigo 7.1:1, Night on Periwinkle 7.3:1.

tokens.name: avatar
tokens.usage: Haze / Dusk. The disc behind an account's initial or tail.

tokens.name: avatar-ink
tokens.usage: The initial on avatar: 5.7:1 in light, 7.8:1 in dark.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Marigold: the one warm note. Fills only, small: the "Follows you" chip and a new follower's dot. Never text or a mark on bg in light (1.85:1).

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on a highlight fill: Ink 9.6:1, Night 10.0:1.

tokens.name: highlight-ink
tokens.usage: Marigold as text, when a word must carry it without a fill: Marigold Deep on Paper 5.9:1, Marigold on Night 10.0:1.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. At least 6.5:1 on bg and soft in both themes.

families.sans: "Schibsted Grotesk", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name set as live text in a header, where the outlined wordmark file can't be used. Title case, never lowercase.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: One follow list for every app.
styles.usage: One per page: the home headline. 26px under 520px wide. Sentence case.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: A person's page: their handle or account tail.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Follow someone once and every app that reads Follows knows it.
styles.usage: All running text, 16px minimum on screens.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons and the active tab. Sentence case, one or two words.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels, in muted. Sentence case; Follows uses no all-caps labels.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Counts and secondary links. Turn on tabular figures where numbers stack.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: No coins needed: this device's work pays each fee.
styles.usage: The note under a button, and image captions. The floor: nothing smaller.

styles.name: address
styles.usage: Account tails, full addresses and CIDs: anything a person reads character by character or compares. Lowercase, as the chain writes it.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a count and its label; inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a field and its button; between stacked links.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Avatar to name in a row; list-title margin.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Field and button inner padding; the page's side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, search fields, panels.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: The app icon and favicon tile: 22% of the tile's side (7px at 32, 113px at 512).

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Avatars and the mark's own discs.

size.note: Logo minimum sizes, as rendered on screen. Print minimums are in the Logo section.

tokens.name: min-lockup
tokens.usage: Narrowest horizontal lockup (mark 12px tall).

tokens.name: min-stacked
tokens.usage: Narrowest stacked lockup.

tokens.name: min-wordmark
tokens.usage: Narrowest wordmark alone.

tokens.name: min-mark
tokens.usage: Narrowest mark alone; below this use the favicon tile.

tokens.name: min-tile
tokens.usage: The favicon tile at its smallest.
